sam: Heads up — we need a fast rebuild of the base-image (ubuntu-minimal v1.14) to pick up libssl CVE-2026-1234. Target window Fri 2026-03-27 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need RBAC tweak for signer, KMS rotation, and audit retention checks. Who can own what?

anika: I can take RBAC. Which service account will sign artifacts? is it `svc-account:image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`?

marco: yes that's the one. Also need to rotate the GCP KMS key used by our signer. If we rotate, we must re-sign artifacts (cosign) and update provenance metadata. Can we do a staging canary first?

sam: staging canary for 30m, then prod canary at 5% for 1h, then full. Need audit logs forwarded to long-term bucket before the key rotation. @liu will you be oncall for rollback?

liu: available. Rollback plan looks straightforward: disable new KMS key version + redeploy previous signed manifest. Quick command in playbook: `gcloud kms keys versions disable --name=...`

jess: quick Q — do we need to change IAM bindings for the new signer key? Current binding gives `roles/cloudkms.signer` to `svc-account:image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

anika: yes we should tighten to least privilege + add a conditional binding for project and service account use. I'll open a PR with proposed policy.

deploy-bot: image-scan: found 1 medium vuln in current base (libssl CVE-2026-1234). Ticket created: SEC-2026-112

sam: add note to ticket: update SBOM and include cosign signatures in release metadata. Marco — can CI automatically re-sign after we rotate the key?

marco: Pipeline change is small. Add step post-build: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/project/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signerKey/cryptoKeyVersions/1`. I'll draft the pipeline patch.

anika: also: audit logging. We need to preserve key-access audit logs for 90 days and export Cloud KMS logs to the long-term-bucket. Ops/infra confirmation?

liu: confirmed with ops: retention 90d. I'll add an alert if the signer key is used outside the deploy window or from unexpected identities.

sam: schedule: staging build + sign (Fri 02:00), staging canary 02:30-03:00, prod canary 03:00-04:00 (5% traffic), then full 04:00-04:30. Who owns prod canary monitoring?

jess: :raising_hand: I'll own prod canary monitoring — will watch latency, error rates, and vulns.

sam: great. Tasks summary: anika — IAM policy PR; marco — CI/cosign patch + pipeline test; jess — prod canary owner; liu — rollback runbook + alerts; sam — coordinate window, update SEC ticket and notify compliance.

sam: pasting minimal runbook snippet here for visibility:

```
Runbook: base-image rebuild & signer rotation
- Build base image in staging (pipeline `base-image-build`)\n- Produce SBOM (syft) and store in artifacts bucket\n- Sign artifact with cosign using KMS key:\n  `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...`\n- Verify signature and provenance (cosign verify + sbom check)\n- Staging canary: 30m\n- Prod canary: 5% traffic, 1h\n- Full roll: gradual to 100% over 30m\nRollback steps:\n- Disable/deny new KMS key version immediately: `gcloud kms keys versions disable ...`\n- Redeploy previous signed manifest (tag: `v1.13-signed`)\n- Notify sec/infra and open post-roll analysis ticket
```

anika: will open IAM PR and link it into SEC-2026-112.

marco: will push pipeline patch to `infra/ci` and add a dry-run flag for staging tests.

liu: I'll add 2 alerts: unusual KMS usage + audit export failure.

jess: I'll put monitoring dashboard snapshots into the ticket during canary.

sam: thanks all. I'll update the ticket with this plan and the runbook. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

marco: quick note — cosign key URI will change after rotation. I'll add both old + new URIs to the pipeline config so verification works across the cutover.

anika: perfect. Also proposing we limit the signer SA to only the CI project and add a time-limited binding for the rotation window.

liu: acknowledged. I'll run a preflight check tomorrow to verify audit export and alerting.

jess: ready on my side.

sam: closing loop — will post final runbook + timeline in SEC-2026-112 by EOD.
